{{Top|leg}}
The '''analysts''' served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] by transforming scattered intelligence into actionable insight. These experts pieced together data collected by [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]], [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], and [[Spy/Legends|spies]], using logic, intuition, and experience to uncover patterns and hidden truths. Some analysts specialized in decoding Rebel operations or monitoring [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] movements, while others advised [[Politics/Legends|political]] and military leaders by offering critical research and cultural insight.<ref name="Desperate Allies">''[[Desperate Allies]]''</ref>

On the battlefield and in diplomacy alike, analysts identified key trends and connections that influenced major decisions. They helped [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] anticipate enemy strategies, assisted [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermasters]] in preparing for environmental conditions, and ensured diplomats understood local customs. Though they worked best with access to archives and networks, skilled analysts adapted quickly in the field, analyzing live situations to reveal enemy weaknesses. Their contributions proved vital to the success and survival of many Rebel missions.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Analyst was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
